prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: calligraphy glyph source sheet for a software animation experiment. White background, flat scan, black ink. EXACTLY five horizontal rows on an invisible six-column grid, each cell the same size with ample white clearance between characters; left aligned, one character per cell. Rows 3,4,5 contain FIVE characters and the sixth cell stays blank. Do not center short rows. Exact text with traditional characters: row 1 人有悲歡離合; row 2 月有陰晴圓缺; row 3 此事古難全; row 4 但願人長久; row 5 千里共嬋娟. No punctuation, no labels, no English, no seals, no ruling lines, no paper decoration. Render each complete character accurately. Landscape canvas about 1800 by 1500. Style: Yan Zhenqing-inspired Tang regular script 顏真卿楷書, broad dignified structure, strong fleshy verticals, comparatively fine horizontal shafts, rounded concealed brush entries, expansive balanced forms and resolute turns, warm dense ink, inspiration from 多寶塔碑 and 顏勤禮碑. Clearly distinguish this from lean angular Liu Gongquan. Solid connected strokes, minimal dry brush, readable traditional Kaishu.

Style: elegant mature Han-dynasty clerical script 隸書, inspired by 曹全碑. Distinctly wide, flattened characters, horizontal extension, silkworm-head starts and swallowtail finishes 蠶頭燕尾, 波磔, measured graceful undulations, balanced restrained pressure. Definitely clerical script, not regular script or seal script. Horizontal strokes broaden into lifted flaring tails, verticals short and firm. Solid connected dark ink, minimal dry-brush gaps.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: blank paper background for vertical Chinese calligraphy animation. Portrait 3:4 aspect ratio. Very light warm ivory xuan paper, subtle natural fibers. Only a LITTLE delicate pale warm gray and pale beige decoration: a very faint traditional cloud motif near upper right margin and a wispy bamboo leaf silhouette at the far lower left edge, fine double hairline border set close to page edges. At least 90 percent of the surface is almost blank light ivory. Central writing rectangle from 6% to94% of width and 8% to92% of height must remain visually quiet. Decorations very low contrast, small and confined to outer margins. Elegant, airy, restrained. No text, no characters, no stamps, no moon, no strong vignette, no dark objects.
